_doc: GENERIC profiling ladder + stamping. The per-backend native profiler is NOT listed here -- it is read from each backend's manifest.json (the SSOT: profiler.name + capabilities.metrics + profiler.to_evidence), so this file never drifts from the backends. This registry only defines: the fallback methods, the order to try them, how to stamp each kind, and probe-tool aliases for backends whose profiler name != host binary.

native_stamp._note: Generic stamp for a native hw profiler. The strategist overrides evidence to 'ncu' when profiler_name is literally ncu (Nsight Compute); other native profilers (rocprof/msprof/vtune/metal-capture) keep 'native_profiler' so provenance is honest rather than借用 ncu.
